purpose: Present relative time with a machine-readable instant and an absolute timestamp tooltip.
behaviorProvider: Intl relative/absolute formatters and shared Tooltip; local clock interval.

component: Convert string/number values with Date and show an Unavailable span for nonfinite timestamps. The invalid replacement does not forward time props, className or tabIndex.

Use explicit now as a fixed reference without scheduling an interval. Otherwise initialize from Date.now and update at a minimum one-second interval; clear the interval on unmount or dependency change.
Render a time element with ISO dateTime, absolute title and an aria-label combining relative and absolute values. Default tabIndex is zero so the shared absolute tooltip is keyboard reachable.
host: Supply a valid finite now when deterministic historical or server/client rendering matters. Invalid now, locale or timeZone are not caught as a graceful fallback.
Choose updateInterval for the domain and avoid treating displayed text as exact elapsed-time arithmetic. Multiple live instances each create their own timer.

Use rounded seconds to choose second/minute/hour/day/month/year units, return just now below ten seconds, and floor unit magnitudes with a minimum of one. Months use thirty days and years use 365 days.
Use Intl.RelativeTimeFormat for full relative phrases and Intl.DateTimeFormat for absolute timestamps with supplied locale/timeZone. Compact abbreviations and just now are fixed English strings.
Supply a valid finite now when deterministic historical or server/client rendering matters. Invalid now, locale or timeZone are not caught as a graceful fallback.
Choose updateInterval for the domain and avoid treating displayed text as exact elapsed-time arithmetic. Multiple live instances each create their own timer.
Consume data-display group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: Approximate relative units do not use calendar-aware month/year arithmetic.
No live-region announcement is added for ticking text; there is no global shared clock.
